Bombay High Court convicts Tarun Tejpal in 2013 sexual assault case

The Goa Bench of the Bombay High Court convicted former Tehelka editor Tarun Tejpal in a 2013 sexual assault case, overturning a 2021 acquittal. The court ordered Tejpal to be present for sentencing, which was scheduled for the afternoon. The Solicitor General, appearing for the Goa government, sought the maximum punishment to emphasize a "no means no" message. The case involves allegations by a woman journalist who accused Tejpal of sexual assault in a hotel elevator in November 2013. A trial court had initially acquitted Tejpal of all charges in 2021.
